name: Broken Sword: The Shadow of the Templars
aliases: Broken Sword: Shadow of the Templars - Director's Cut
Broken Sword: Shadow of the Templars - Reforged

locations.note: A café bombing by the Palais Royal pulls tourist George Stobbart into the Templar mystery; Paris is the hub he returns to between every trip, down to the Templar chamber under Montfauçon.
George follows the manuscript to a dig at Lochmarne castle, where the archaeologist Peagram has vanished.
At the village of Marib George finds the Bull's Head rock and, in a cave beneath it, a lens and a Baphomet idol.
The de Vasconcellos villa and mausoleum give up the family chalice, and a second visit opens the well in the grounds.
The night train north ends under the church ruins at Bannockburn, where the Neo-Templars gather for the finale.

routes.name: George's investigation
routes.note: Paris is the hub: George comes back to Nico's flat after Ireland, Syria and each of two trips to Spain before the train to Scotland.
